summary: Phase 2 (multi-company, chat sessions, premium/Stripe, mock bank connect) fully tested. 13/13 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend E2E covers: company selector list+switch+create (isolation confirmed — new company shows 0 entries and different dashboard totals), chat history sidebar with resume/delete/new-chat, /futuro paywall for non-premium with unlock button navigating to /planos, Pricing page listing premium_monthly and premium_yearly plans with real Stripe checkout redirect to checkout.stripe.com (verified 'Subscribe to CEO AI Premium — US$22.54/month' page), /futuro after premium shows chart + working AI simulator returning verdict/summary/impact, and Finances connect-bank-btn imports 48 movements and marks bank_connected. Fixed one real 500 bug on GET /api/chat/sessions (KeyError from orphan docs with old field 'sid').

minor.issue: Threw 500 KeyError('session_id') because 3 orphan chat_sessions docs used legacy field name 'sid'. FIXED: (1) migrated docs via mongosh $rename sid→session_id, (2) added defensive .get() + $exists filter in server.py line 601-604. Non-blocking, no data loss.
Returns HTTP 500 for unknown lookup_key. Would be nicer as 400 (bad request) since it's a client-side identifier error, not a server error. Non-blocking.

issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for screen readers on the 'Criar empresa' dialog.

Stripe displays subtotal in USD (US$22.54) with FX note '1 EUR = 1.1864 USD'. Because Stripe Sandbox account currency is USD. Prices in /planos page correctly show €19/mês. Consider aligning Stripe price currency with UI to avoid confusion for PT customers, but this is a Stripe account/config concern, not a code bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL: main agent could add DialogDescription to <Dialog> in AppLayout (new-company dialog) and in Finances (add-entry dialog) to silence Radix a11y warning.
OPTIONAL: Consider returning 400 instead of 500 in /api/payments/checkout for unknown lookup_key.
OPTIONAL: If Stripe products must display in EUR, ensure the Stripe price object for premium_monthly/premium_yearly is set to EUR (may require account-level currency alignment in Stripe dashboard).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/chat/sessions previously assumed 'session_id' field always exists — brittle against legacy/partial docs. Fixed with defensive .get() + $exists filter.
resolve_company + active_company_id + entries filtering by company_id looks correct; the one-time orphan migration for entries without company_id is elegant and idempotent.
POST /api/companies auto-activates the newly created company — sensible UX; frontend already redirects to '/' after creation.
/api/future and /api/future/simulate correctly gated via is_premium() helper (403 with detail='premium_required'). Frontend correctly detects 403 and shows paywall.

/api/payments/status/{session_id} polls Stripe when not yet paid and activates premium — correct pattern; the same activation is also mirrored via /api/stripe/webhook. Idempotent because payment_status filter blocks double-update.
/api/bank/connect creates ~40-50 randomised entries with fixed description 'Movimento bancário (demo)' — makes cleanup trivial. It correctly requires an active company.
server.py is now ~830 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold. Recommend splitting into auth/company/entries/ai/payments modules for maintainability.
AppLayout uses <DialogContent> without <DialogDescription> — Radix warns. Not a functional bug, just an a11y nit.

chat POST route creates a session doc when session_id is None — good; but note that the DB collection has no unique index on session_id, so hypothetically duplicates could form on retry. Not observed.

rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/chat/sessions 500 KeyError('session_id'): three legacy chat_sessions docs (created by an earlier revision of the code) stored the session id under 'sid' instead of 'session_id'. The listing endpoint used bracket-notation s['session_id'] which raises KeyError on those docs. Reproduction: mongosh insert of {user_id, sid:'x'} then GET /api/chat/sessions → 500. Mitigation applied: (a) db.chat_sessions.updateMany({sid:{$exists:true}}, {$rename:{sid:'session_id'}}) to migrate legacy docs, (b) server.py now uses s.get('session_id') and filters find({'session_id':{'$exists':True}}) so future partial docs cannot break the endpoint.
